nodes.body: { 🎮 Game Releases } _Ludicrousda3ve_ released [Sayonara, Space Rocks](https://ludicrousda3ve.itch.io/adios-asteroids-arcade-demo) demo, a high scoring asteroid-blasting game and [TNA](https://ludicrousda3ve.itch.io/tna), an 18+ spin on it.

{ 🧑‍💻 Dev Updates } _James C. Kane_ updated [STARSPEED](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/james-c-kane_two-new-kilometer-scale-starspeed-missions-activity-7480685679312793600-VVoQ) with some new missions! Pursue rogue AI through the luxury space station Saturnalia toward a boss battle inside Earth's capital ship 🪐🛳️
{ 🎮 Game Releases } _Graphite Lab_ released [Centipede Swarm](https://luna.amazon.com/game/centipede-swarm/B0FP79K7WS), a reimagining of the classic Centipede for Amazon’s Luna game service

{ 🧑‍💻 Dev Updates } _Cheezy-Z_ has been working on programming multiplayer client server replication in a [basketball style game](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g3EWqgYvRp4) with working [passing, inbounding, ref pickup + passing to another player](https://x.com/Cheezy_UNI/status/2079024611946061848)!

{ 🕹️ Game Jam Releases } _Xain Russell_ helped to make [Sky's Landline](https://steamstuckdragon.itch.io/skys-landline) for [Furry Game Jam #2](https://itch.io/jam/furries)! Sky's Landline is an infinite upwards high-score-chasing platformer, where you must ascend through the structure of a colossal radio tower, linking the main data cable from relay console to relay console, acquiring temporary upgrades along the way, and racing against the degrading battery of your jetpack as you try to get as high as you can!

{ 🕹️ Game Jam Releases } _Dorian K, azeTrom, StarBiscute, Poyumonium, _and_ F1r3-Dragon_ made [Mixtape Match](https://cutloaf.itch.io/mixtape-match), a music memory matching game where you listen closely, then pick out exactly which tracks played. Each round layers more sounds into the mix, testing how sharp your ear really is before the clock runs out. Made for the [GMTK Jam](https://itch.io/jam/gmtk-jam-2026)! Out of over 10k entries in the jam, right now, the game is ranked #9 in the audio category!

{ 🎮 Game Releases } _Butterscotch Shenanigans_ released How Many Dudes? on [Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3934270/How_Many_Dudes/), [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/how-many-dudes/id6753077755), and [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bscotch.hmd)! How many dudes does it take to beat up a gorilla? A thousand toddlers? A horse-sized duck? A GOD? Enter the Dude Ranch and find out in this roguelike dudebuilder where you recruit an army of dudes to fight ridiculous battles. Fat Bard has also released the [soundtrack](https://fatbard.bandcamp.com/album/how-many-dudes)!
{ 🧑‍💻 Dev Updates } _Tony Wojnar_ is done with the [environment art for the Glitch Ditch](https://bsky.app/profile/tonywojnar.bsky.social/post/3mrzmmplh4c2j) level in Dribble 2!

{ 🎮 Game Releases } _Fat Bard_ worked on the music for [Signy & Mino: Against All Gods](https://bsky.app/profile/fatbard.com/post/3mrurqjqqik26), a Tag-Team Battle RPG where every move combos together! Discover your hidden powers as you find yourself hurtled into a conflict among the gods!

{ 🕹️ Game Jam Releases } _Dustin Triplett_ made [Dopaminer](https://dustintriplett.itch.io/dopaminer) for the [The Kenney Jam 2026](https://itch.io/jam/kenney-jam-2026), a frantic fulfillment game about chasing tiny hits of happiness through online shopping, fast shipping, and the sweet satisfaction of adding things to a cart YOU don't actually have to pay for.

{ 🎮 Game Releases } _Wes Ehrlichman_ created [Time To Rogue](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/time-to-rogue/id6786902468), a roguelike for your Apple Watch that lives on your wrist and plays out over your day - the maze keeps moving while you're away. How deep can you get before it finds you?
{ 🧑‍💻 Dev Updates } _Izzy_ has been working on a personal [javascript canvas library](https://bsky.app/profile/cr1ttr.bsky.social/post/3mqlkzihg7225) for blogging and prototyping
{ 🎼 Music Releases } The Colisino Original Soundtrack, by _Elliot Hely_, is available to download from [Bandcamp](https://axolstudio.bandcamp.com/album/the-colisino-original-soundtrack) FOR FREE!

{!header} July was packed with progress, great conversations on the Discord, and exciting moments from the STLGameDev community. Our monthly meetup was at [Schlafly Bottleworks](https://bsky.app/profile/stlgame.dev/post/3mqconqjp222v), and we showed off games made in the community at [MOGameCon](https://bsky.app/profile/stlgame.dev/post/3mrna46mchk2g)! Here's a look back at what happened throughout the month!

{ 🎼 Music Releases } _Nathan Amiri_ put together an interactive [Soundboard](https://machine-box.itch.io/soundboard) collaboration that lets you mix and match audio tracks made by community members Laz, Duk, Auron, Star, Tim and Nathan himself.
